## 3. Services & Engagement Models

1. Full-Stack Web Application Development:
   - Modern server-side rendered (SSR) and statically generated (SSG) web applications built on Next.js 16 and React 19.
   - Core Web Vitals optimization, high accessibility (a11y), responsive across all desktop, tablet, and mobile breakpoints.
2. Custom SaaS Product Engineering:
   - Multi-tenant cloud architectures, Stripe/Razorpay payment gateway integrations, role-based access control (RBAC), and analytics dashboards.
3. Backend Architecture & RESTful APIs:
   - High-throughput Node.js/Express.js services, modular routing, structured error handling, JWT-secured endpoints, rate limiting, and automated testing.
4. Database Modeling & Performance Optimization:
   - Schema design, indexing strategies, aggregation pipelines, and data caching using MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Supabase, and MySQL.
5. Interactive 3D & Creative Frontend:
   - Three.js, WebGL shaders, GSAP timelines, and Framer Motion spring physics for immersive product showcases and visual experiences.
6. WhatsApp API & Automation Bots:
   - 24/7 automated conversational workflows for clinic bookings, customer service, order updates, and CRM integrations via WhatsApp Cloud API and n8n.
7. Enterprise Business Software Suites:
   - Bespoke management software replacing rigid ERPs: Inventory Control, Barcode/QR generation, Point of Sale / GST Invoicing, CRM, and Field Staff Dispatch.
